query: SELECT x.id FROM eval_executions x JOIN eval_experiments e ON e.id=x.experiment_id JOIN eval_workers w ON w.id=x.lease_owner WHERE x.id=$1 AND e.owner_id=$2 AND w.owner_id=$2 AND w.id=$3 AND w.enabled AND w.expires_at>NOW() AND x.fencing_token=$4 AND x.status='running' AND e.status='running' AND x.lease_expires_at>NOW() AND x.deadline_at>NOW()
